I’m a designer who likes turning ideas into things that actually work.

I work across product, visual, and interaction design — shaping everything from early concepts and user flows to polished interfaces and design systems. I care about the details that make a product feel clear, useful, and enjoyable.

I also like building what I design. When an idea needs to move beyond a prototype, I turn it into a real working experience using SwiftUI, Kotlin, or web technologies. It helps me understand the product beyond the pixels and push ideas further.

These days, I’m exploring AI-first ways of researching, designing, prototyping, and building — using AI to explore more ideas, move faster, and create better products.

You can find me on Behance, GitHub, App Store, LinkedIn and LeetCode,
or reach me by email.
